name: Cafe Kitsuné
description: is a stylish French bakery and coffee shop located in Canggu, known for its quality coffee, French pastries, and a charming atmosphere. It is part of the larger Desa Kitsuné complex, which includes a restaurant, nightclub, and Maison Kitsuné boutique. The café offers a fusion of Japanese and French influences, serving items like specialty lattes, ube drinks, and cakes.
priceRange: Pastries & coffees ~ Rp 18.000 – Rp 80.000; coffees & speciality drinks ~ Rp 35.000 – Rp 55.000; full light-meal / brunch menu ~ Rp 55.000 – Rp 150.000 per person
